craft_notes: Sthāyin: the arithmetic seal. Sanskrit-first: pañcaiva kept exactly-five; ṣaṭtriṃśattattvāni kept thirty-six-tattvas. Rows: 1 ('compose the thirty-six tattvas' closes — the number end-weight). Close: 'compose the thirty-six tattvas.' Rejected: writing numerals as words differently — kept thirty-six (house form); 'constitute' — kept make (compose is the arithmetical sense).

reads_against.argmap: How do five kalās make thirty-six? → Pañca-kalā × sapta-tattva = ṣaṭtriṃśat: the arithmetic of the scheme.
c1_essence: Exactly five kalās make thirty-six tattvas.
